context: Mrs. Mori brings flowers from her garden to Yumiko's house.
purpose: Two older women sharing simple seasonal gift.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: The flowers in my garden have started blooming.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Soft pride in the observation — not boasting, just sharing something noticed. Gentle cadence, like she's settling into a pleasant bit of news.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Genuine delight with a slight intake of breath. Immediate, warm response. Short phrases with weight behind them. Eyes brightening in the voice.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Spring has really come, hasn't it.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wistful. Soft certainty. Slight pause before the closing phrase, as if she's watching the season arrive in real time. Warm nostalgia.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いただきます、活けます。
lines.en: I'll take them — and arrange them beautifully.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude layered with gentle purpose. Light emphasis on the second part — this is care she can offer. Warm, capable tone. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.style: Soft, genuine laugh. Affectionate send-off with no edge. Slight trail of warmth at the end. The pleasure of being the one who gave something small and meaningful.
